Financial Literacy

Financial Literacy & Numeracy Skills

We believe education should prepare students not only for academic success but also for real-life challenges. That's why we place a strong emphasis on Financial Literacy and Numeracy Skills—empowering students with the knowledge and confidence to make smart, responsible decisions in everyday life.

In today’s fast-paced world, understanding money is a life skill. Financial literacy helps students:

● Understand the value of money
● Make informed spending and saving decisions
● Develop budgeting and planning habits
● Learn about banking, investments, and digital payments
● Become responsible and independent decision-makers


Our partnership with OLUXI Smart Skills reflects our vision of nurturing young individuals who are academically strong, emotionally intelligent, financially aware, and socially responsible.

Numeracy: More Than Just Numbers

Numeracy is more than basic arithmetic—it’s the ability to apply math in practical situations. At DPS Gomtinagar Jnr. , we integrate numeracy skills into daily learning, helping students:

● Solve real-world problems with logic and accuracy
● Interpret data and use mathematical reasoning
● Understand measurements, time, and financial calculations
● Strengthen mental math and estimation skills

These capabilities are essential not only in academics but also in everyday tasks and future

Our programs are designed to be engaging, interactive, and age-appropriate, featuring:

● Classroom activities and role-plays (e.g., mock stores, budgeting games)
● Workshops and seminars on money management
● Real-life simulations, like planning an event or managing a small project budget
● Math labs and digital tools to support concept clarity
● Integrated learning across subjects like economics, math, and ICT
● Develop confident, financially aware students
● Promote The practical application of math in daily life
● Encourage critical thinking and responsible choices
● Build skills that support entrepreneurship and financial independence
Preparing students for life—one smart decision at a time.
